frequency_question: How often do authorities successfully scale declared financial intervention programs to their target volumes when they have the operational capability?
membership_rule: Includes discretionary Treasury or Central Bank market intervention programs (e.g., Fed QE/QT pacing adjustments, ECB PEPP volume adjustments, US Treasury buyback announcements) where the issuer sets a multi-billion dollar volume trajectory. Excludes statutory legislative programs requiring external congressional appropriations.

cases.name: US Treasury regular buyback program rollout (2024)
Federal Reserve SOMA portfolio cap increases (2017)
Bank of Japan JGB purchase pace adjustments (2016)
Bank of England gilt market functional intervention (2022)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named; representative of major sovereign debt management office and central bank operational scaling events.
known_gaps: Excludes minor emerging market interventions where administrative capacity might fail.
validity_reason: Sovereign operational execution standards and treasury management capabilities change slowly over decades.
